notes.title: Building system improvements
notes.notes:
Hey! From the moment of publishing the Steam page, I was working on improving the building system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890005/3c69f5568f4adad5741a88a9a646958e6b8f1801.png[/img]
Previously, you could find that land plots were very simple: some area with a fence and a building right in the middle. I thought it's very boring and would like to make the generation more meaningful and interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890005/239a9e010dd3620f4a9ac36198d0a8d3c919d56e.gif[/img]

Since then, I have been trying different ways to generate land plots that will look like a real place that human beings can live in. Here are some examples of what the new system can generate. This is still a work in progress feature that will be improved during the development process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890005/e8e786a4bcf641d641b67c827d58a0c132b65b51.png[/img]
